exception_title: Motion to Reopen vs Reconsider Conflation
exception_description: Petitioner checks both boxes; system must require election of one ground or process under stricter standard.
33-calendar-day deadline computed from decision date; system uses business days; motion accepted when time-barred.

exception_title: Fee Waiver Arithmetic on Multiple Motions
exception_description: Multiple motions filed same day; fee waiver granted for one but not cascaded to companion filing; underpayment.
I-290B filed by beneficiary on petition where only petitioner has standing; system accepts without standing check.
Motion on I-140 denial must go to AAO; system routes to local adjudications office; wrong jurisdiction.
Decision notice date stamp ink-bleed; OCR reads wrong date; 33-day window calculated from incorrect start.

exception_title: New Evidence Submitted on Motion to Reconsider
exception_description: Motion to reconsider includes new evidence; legally impermissible; system accepts attachment without flagging.

exception_title: Legal Argument vs New Evidence Classification
exception_description: LLM classifies new-fact submission as legal argument; allows it on reconsideration when it should be reopening.
Petitioner files reopen, then reconsider on same RFE response denial; stacking not tracked; each toll different clock.

exception_title: Motion Filed on Administratively Closed Case
exception_description: I-290B filed on case closed by immigration court; USCIS lacks jurisdiction but issues receipt.
Decision issued Sep 30; I-290B filed Oct 5 of new FY; fee schedule change between dates causes underpayment.

exception_title: Attorney Misconduct Flag Not Carried Forward
exception_description: Prior I-290B flagged for attorney misconduct; flag not inherited by subsequent motion on same file.
LLM does not flag motion as futile when controlling circuit precedent clearly bars the relief sought.
Law firm with multi-client AAO queue can view motion status of other firms' cases through shared portal endpoint.

exception_title: Motion Outcome Not Written to Base Record
exception_description: I-290B approved (reopen); base petition record remains 'denied'; downstream systems use stale denial status.
